title: Fast check stays fast when a widely imported module changes
body:
Outcome: `npm run fast` stays fast when a widely imported module changes.
Evidence: lane t-jsf5jbm 2026-11-19: a change to src/brain/worker-packet.ts planned 96 tests (38 spawn-entry + 43 import consumers) and ran 1450 s at host load ~25; the fast check gated the lane for ~25 min.
Proof: the same change plans and runs in under 3 min, with CI still running the full suite.
